request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Lotus Veil Spirit".

Creative brief
Name: Lotus Veil Spirit
Collection: Mirebound Court. Swamp creatures serving a drowned marsh court, marked by reeds, lilies, mud, spores, leeches, and deceptive water formations.
Core concept: A drifting support enemy that hides slow projectiles beneath floating petals.
Body and silhouette: Small faceless spirit with a wide lotus-petal hood and tapering waterlike lower body.
Signature features: Layered flower hood, glowing inner face, and two floating lily leaves.
Palette and materials: Dusky pink, muted teal, pale cream, and soft blue light.
Movement personality: Serene, gliding, and deceptively gentle.
Attack concept: Releases large petals that drift outward before opening to reveal a faster water droplet continuing in the same direction.
Directional details: One outer petal is darkened on the lower-left side.
Avoid: Human fairy, beautiful princess face, excessive transparency.
